fiscal_control_periods_completion_check.name: fiscal_control_periods_completion_check
fiscal_control_periods_completion_check.value: ("fiscal_control_periods"."status" = 'completed' AND "fiscal_control_periods"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "fiscal_control_periods"."completed_by" IS NOT NULL) OR ("fiscal_control_periods"."status" <> 'completed' AND "fiscal_control_periods"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "fiscal_control_periods"."completed_by" IS NULL)

fiscal_import_rows_resolved_check.name: fiscal_import_rows_resolved_check
fiscal_import_rows_resolved_check.value: "fiscal_import_rows"."status" NOT IN ('matched', 'imported') OR "fiscal_import_rows"."resolved_client_id" IS NOT NULL

tasks_assignee_or_clan_check.name: tasks_assignee_or_clan_check
tasks_assignee_or_clan_check.value: "tasks"."assignee_id" IS NOT NULL OR "tasks"."clan_id" IS NOT NULL

xp_ledger_task_event_uidx.name: xp_ledger_task_event_uidx
xp_ledger_task_event_uidx.where: task_event_id IS NOT NULL AND reason IN ('task_completed', 'reversal')
